gotchas: The storefront and product pages are on www.newegg.com while the cart, the sign-in gate and the checkout are on secure.newegg.com. The cart cookie carries across, so opening the cart URL directly is fine, but reach the sign-in gate by clicking Proceed to Checkout, because its URL carries a one-time token.

The buy box add button is .product-buy-box button.btn-wide. The other 6 to 15 buttons whose text reads Add to cart are recommendation tiles and the marketplace more-options box, so never match by text alone.

A search URL with the sold-by-Newegg facet and lowest-price ordering keeps the results first party, and hrefs carrying SoldByNewegg=1 are the first-party ones. A product page can also show a sponsored tile above the buy box, so read the price from .product-buy-box.

The sign-in gate is not an account wall: the guest button sits below the social sign-in buttons, out of view. Click button:has-text('guest checkout'), matched case insensitively, and the one-page checkout comes up 10 to 16 seconds later. Stopping at that gate is what made an earlier drive report no address form.

Contact is one full-name field rather than first and last. The street field is an address search box with autocomplete disabled and no suggestion list appeared, so press Escape and carry on. The state select takes two-letter values that follow the military codes, and the country select has no name and is preselected.

The text Deliver to this address appears on three buttons; the one in the step header is button.checkout-step-action-done. After it the step collapses to a normalized address with no confirmation prompt and the payment step opens.

The card form is a first-party iframe with the billing address inside it, so the card, expiry, CVV and billing fills all target the same frame. Scope it by id: a source match for the payment edit path counts 2 because two hidden shells sit in the body, while #neweggpay-iframe-penpal is the visible modal frame.
There is no billing same-as-shipping checkbox inside the card frame, so the billing address has to be typed.
The main document's #Card_Number and #Security_Code are the gift-card fields under Gift Card and Promo Code, not the card form.
Custom checkout, not one of the executable platform playbooks. Guest cart at secure.newegg.com/shop/cart.

Product cards on a search results page use selector a.item-title; the product page's add-to-cart control is button:has-text("Add to cart") (two matches observed: a sticky header copy and the main one).
notes: Driven locally and through the Agent Vault proxy in September 2026 from the product page to the card frame: add to cart, the cart on secure.newegg.com, the guest button on the sign-in gate, the one-page checkout filled field by field, Deliver to this address, Add a credit or debit card, then the card number, expiry, CVV and Add this card controls inside the payment frame, each counting 1. The card was not filled, so the status is unverified. No wall was seen anywhere on the route and the run took about 116 seconds through the proxy.
